1 · Intro

When to use it.

Most staff recruiting runs through Cielo, Vanderbilt's recruiting partner, which focuses on roles at M4 and below. Executive roles usually go to a search firm, and that changes how the requisition is created.

Use this whenThe role will be filled through an executive search or an outside search firm.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle Recruiting. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Confirm with central recruiting before you start an executive search.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Create a Job Requisition (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1You're using an outside search firm. What do you create?

Q2Cielo generally recruits roles at which levels?

Q3When do you pick Executive search as the requisition type?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Executive or External Search

Use when: The role will be filled through an executive search or an outside search firm. · System: Oracle Recruiting

  1. Cielo's executive search program: a recruiting requisition marked Executive search.
  2. Any other firm (for example, Korn Ferry): a PO requisition, not a recruiting requisition.
  3. Everything else: Standard or Abbreviated.

Watch-outs

  • Confirm with central recruiting before you start an executive search.
